SCENE: पापा standing in the courtyard looking at the golden glow before the niche, कुकु beside पापा looking up, फ्यूरिया, लेडा, कैस्टर and वैस्पर standing around on the flagstones looking at पापा
subject[0].name: KUKU
subject[0].species: paper dragon child
subject[0].colour: green
subject[0].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[0].pose: कुकु stands beside पापा, looking up at पापा, quiet

subject[1].name: FYURIA
subject[1].species: paper dragon child
subject[1].colour: bright pink-red
subject[1].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[1].pose: फ्यूरिया stands at the right, looking at पापा

subject[2].name: LEDA
subject[2].species: paper dragon child
subject[2].colour: lilac-purple
subject[2].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[2].pose: लेडा stands at the left, looking at पापा

subject[3].name: CASTOR
subject[3].species: paper dragon child
subject[3].colour: golden-yellow
subject[3].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[3].pose: कैस्टर stands at the right end, bouncing on both feet

subject[4].name: VESPER
subject[4].species: paper dragon child
subject[4].colour: pale blue
subject[4].scale: knee high to a grown-up, the height of a human child
subject[4].pose: वैस्पर stands at the left end, looking from पापा to the golden glow

subject[5].name: पापा — a grown paper dragon father, taller and broader than कुकु, a plain travelling wrap across पापा's shoulders, the same pale papercraft build as the rest of this family
subject[5].state: पापा stands in the courtyard looking at the golden glow before the niche, astonished

subject[6].name: A SOFT POOL OF WARM GOLDEN LIGHT — a warm golden glow hanging in the air before the niche, its edges fading gently into the dark, about as tall as a seated child
subject[6].state: burning steadily, casting warm gold onto the faces near it and onto the paper stone of the wall behind it
setting.place: दादी's courtyard: a small square of pale paper flagstone walled on every side, a low wall of cut paper blocks along the valley side with a square niche set into it, a wooden paper door in the taller wall, and the paper hills of the valley beyond.
light.state: A warm golden glow standing in the air before the niche is the one source of light. Warm gold falls on the faces near it and on the paper stone of the wall, and the courtyard beyond holds deep blue night.
world.rules:
- the only creatures anywhere in this picture are the ones this prompt names — a world of paper dragons, paper birds and paper animals
- every surface — stone, wood, cloth, banner and sky — is plain blank paper
- THE COURTYARD IS THE ATTACHED PLATE: the same flagstones, the same low wall of cut paper blocks, the same niche in the same place, the same door, the same valley beyond.
- EVERY SURFACE IS CUT PAPER: separate pieces of paper with real thickness, soft rounded cut edges, a fine visible paper grain, and the small soft shadow each piece casts on the one behind it.
- SMALL FORM: कुकु, फ्यूरिया, लेडा, कैस्टर, वैस्पर are each about knee high to a grown-up, and the low wall rises well above the small dragons' heads.
- THE NICHE SHELF IS BARE STONE, in shadow.
- VIEWPOINT: A low three-quarter view across the seated group, the niche at the far side of the frame.
